components.name: BaseFixture
components.label: Base · M8 table mounting plate
components.explanation: Anchors the arm to a rigid bench. Four 9 mm clearance holes on 180 mm PCD; rear service port; central cable passage. Anchoring, mass and bolt selection require structural validation.

components.name: BaseAccent
components.label: Base · removable trim ring
components.explanation: Visual trim and cover seam around the waist stage. Does not carry the arm load.

components.name: WaistHousing
components.label: J1 · waist actuator enclosure
components.explanation: Rotating waist enclosure and central cable route. Its local Z axis follows the first arm joint; bearing and actuator interfaces remain conceptual.

components.name: ShoulderYokeL
components.label: J2 · shoulder yoke L
components.explanation: Support cheek for shoulder pivot. Bore is a placeholder for a bearing-supported output shaft; bearing seat tolerance must be designed.

components.name: ShoulderYokeR
components.label: J2 · shoulder yoke R
components.explanation: Support cheek for shoulder pivot. Bore is a placeholder for a bearing-supported output shaft; bearing seat tolerance must be designed.

components.name: upperShell
components.label: Upper arm · hollow structural shell
components.explanation: 300 mm pivot spacing. Hollow concept housing with 16 mm pivot passages and a front service recess. Wall sizing and torque load paths require analysis.

components.name: upperCover
components.label: Upper arm · service cover
components.explanation: Removable front cover identifies cable and actuator service area. Fasteners, cable strain relief and a complete tendon spool package are not yet detailed.

components.name: upperRootBearingCover
components.label: Upper arm · root bearing cover
components.explanation: External bearing cover and joint-axis marker. The orange bore ring is a visual reference, not a selected commercial bearing.

components.name: upperRootHubRing
components.label: Upper arm · root hub ring
components.explanation: High-contrast marker makes the simulated hinge axis visible when inspecting the mechanism.

components.name: upperTipBearingCover
components.label: Upper arm · tip bearing cover
components.explanation: External bearing cover and joint-axis marker. The orange bore ring is a visual reference, not a selected commercial bearing.

components.name: upperTipHubRing
components.label: Upper arm · tip hub ring
components.explanation: High-contrast marker makes the simulated hinge axis visible when inspecting the mechanism.

components.name: forearmRootHubRing

components.name: WristPitchHousing
components.label: J4 · wrist pitch housing
components.explanation: 60 mm wrist stage. Pitch follows the local Y axis; a through-bore reserves cable space for the hand.

components.name: WristRollCollar
components.label: J5 · wrist roll collar
components.explanation: Visual collar at the hand roll interface. Rotation is around the palm Z axis; a slip ring and cable turn limit must be resolved for physical construction.

components.name: WristFlexionBoot
components.label: Wrist | rounded flexion joint cover
components.explanation: Smooth rounded external joint cover encloses the inherited forearm-to-wrist shell intersection. This visual cover represents a future flexible boot; it is excluded from rigid collision response and does not change the validated wrist articulation.

components.name: AnatomicalPalm
components.label: Palm | tapered metacarpal shell
components.explanation: Smooth oval-section palm widens from a 48 mm wrist to an 82–84 mm metacarpal span. Four rounded knuckle lobes meet the finger roots. This surface defines the human-like palm envelope; internal actuation remains conceptual.

components.name: IndexMetacarpalLobe
components.label: Index | rounded metacarpal lobe
components.explanation: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

components.name: MiddleMetacarpalLobe
components.label: Middle | rounded metacarpal lobe
components.explanation: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

components.name: RingMetacarpalLobe
components.label: Ring | rounded metacarpal lobe
components.explanation: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

components.name: PinkyMetacarpalLobe
components.label: Pinky | rounded metacarpal lobe
components.explanation: Rounded palm-side knuckle transition joins the broad metacarpal contour to the corresponding articulated MCP carrier.

components.name: ThenarEminence
components.label: Palm | rounded thenar eminence
components.explanation: The rounded muscular mound at the thumb base creates the asymmetric human palm silhouette and bridges the wrist to the thumb CMC socket. It is a rigid visual/collision envelope, not simulated muscle.

components.name: HypothenarEminence
components.label: Palm | hypothenar contour
components.explanation: A smaller rounded mound on the little-finger side completes the palm contour and provides a curved support surface.

components.name: CentralPalmPad
components.label: Palm | curved compliant contact insert
components.explanation: Oval, softly domed palmar contact insert. Frictional contact is modeled in physics; real elastomer compliance, durometer and attachment are not yet engineered.

components.name: ThenarPad
components.label: Palm | curved thenar contact insert
components.explanation: Curved thumb-base contact insert follows the thenar mound, helping the palm support objects during opposition.

components.name: DorsalPalmPanel
components.label: Palm | smooth dorsal service cover
components.explanation: A thin rounded dorsal service panel follows the back-of-hand contour. Production fasteners and sealing remain to be selected.

components.name: WristSoftSeal
components.label: Wrist | soft annular transition
components.explanation: Narrow soft transition at the wrist preserves the natural palm taper while making the roll boundary visible.

components.name: indexMCPBall
components.label: Index | rounded MCP carrier
components.explanation: Rounded two-axis knuckle carrier supports independent finger spread and flexion at the same MCP center. Bearing/transmission hardware remains conceptual.

components.name: index_proximalShell
components.label: Index Proximal | smooth tapered shell
components.explanation: 40 mm joint spacing / terminal tip length. Smooth oval cross sections create a rounded knuckle, narrowed shaft and rounded distal knuckle. The shell follows its actual articulation frame; it is a solid digital envelope, not a fabrication-ready tendon housing.

components.name: index_proximalCrease
components.label: Index Proximal | soft joint crease
components.explanation: Short oval soft seam marks the flexion boundary and conceals the hinge interior. Rotation remains about the exact canonical Y hinge; soft deformation is not simulated.

components.name: index_proximalPin
components.label: Index Proximal | hinge axis pin
components.explanation: Brushed-metal 2.1 mm reference pin makes the anatomical hinge axis visible. Pin fits, bearings and retention are conceptual.

components.name: index_proximalPad
components.label: Index Proximal | soft curved pad
components.explanation: Rounded oval palmar pad with domed contact surface. The contact shape and hinge follow the CAD mesh; friction is idealized and no tactile electronics are yet specified.
